categories.name: Person
categories.definition: Named individuals, including historical figures, politicians, athletes, artists, and fictional characters.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: Geographical entities such as countries, cities, towns, islands, mountains, bodies of water, and geological features.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: Formal groups, associations, companies, institutions, government bodies, sports teams, and clubs.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: Artistic and intellectual productions such as films, books, plays, songs, albums, video games, and television programs.

categories.name: Event
categories.definition: Occurrences, incidents, competitions, festivals, battles, and elections that happen at a specific time.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.definition: Vehicles, aircraft, ships, railway lines, roads, and specific models or classes of transportation.

categories.name: Biological Entity
categories.definition: Living organisms including species of animals, plants, fungi, and specific biological proteins or genes.

categories.name: Celestial Object
categories.definition: Astronomical entities such as stars, galaxies, constellations, and planetary bodies.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: Specific human languages, dialects, or language families.

categories.name: Currency
categories.definition: Monetary units and currencies used by countries or regions.

categories.name: Chemical Substance
categories.definition: Chemical elements, compounds, drugs, medications, and distinct molecular structures.

categories.name: Building
categories.definition: Man-made structures including stadiums, theatres, hotels, museums, and specific facilities.

categories.name: Product
categories.definition: Manufactured goods, commercial products, software, and named product lines.

categories.name: Legislation
categories.definition: Laws, acts, treaties, and formal legal documents enacted by a government.

categories.name: Demographic Group
categories.definition: Groups of people defined by nationality, ethnicity, religion, or other shared characteristics.

categories.name: Award
categories.definition: Prizes, honors, and distinctions awarded for achievement.

categories.name: Sports League
categories.definition: Specific leagues, conferences, and divisions within organized sports.

categories.name: Deity
categories.definition: Gods, goddesses, and divine figures from mythology or religion.

categories.name: Educational Degree

categories.name: Title
